body: INVL, an Baltic-based alternative asset manager, has raked in €70.6m in commitments at the first close of its INVL European Banking Opportunities Fund. According to INVL, the fund is a vehicle built to acquire stakes in lenders across Central and Eastern Europe. The commitments came from 41 investors based in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia.
